_comment: NodeCode -> KDP dashboard identity crosswalk. titleId is KDP's internal dashboard id (different from the public ASIN) — it's what lets a link jump straight to a book's edit page at https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/title-setup/kindle/{titleId}/content, skipping the bookshelf hunt-and-click. Harvest by opening the KDP bookshelf, right-clicking 'Edit eBook content' on a title, and copying the href — it contains .../kindle/{titleId}/content. Or paste the raw <a> tag to Claude Code and it will add the entry here. asin/itemSetId are optional extras carried along for reference.
